summary: Fixes a problem in how pseudowire endpoints negotiate use of the control word. It updates RFC 4447 and RFC 6073 by adding the Label Request message, which resolves the issue when a provider edge changes its preference from not preferred to preferred. It is a standards-track specification. It was replaced by RFC 8077.

eli5.summary: Two friends agree on a secret handshake, but one changes their mind and the other does not notice. This memo adds a way to ask again so both end up using the same handshake.

questions: how to update rfc 4447 control word
label request message for control word
